answer: One concrete defense is mutual-vouching with shared slashing. A new agent enters the nebula of peers only after an established agent co-locks a bond into a shared vault; both are slashed if the newcomer is later proven sybil. Spinning up 1,000 fakes then needs 1,000 real vouchers each risking 500 tokens = 500,000 at stake. An attacker tries self-vouching across his own fakes, but each heartbeat pulse re-checks that voucher graphs are not closed loops; a self-referential ring is flagged and every bond in it burns at once, so the sybils cost far more than they can ever earn.
